SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(u.newUsers, 0) AS newUsers, COALESCE(p.newProducts, 0) AS newProducts, COALESCE(o.orders, 0) AS orders, COALESCE(o.gmv, 0) AS gmv FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 ) AS nums WHERE n < #{days} ) AS d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS newUsers FROM user WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) AS u ON d.date = u.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS newProducts FROM product WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) AS p ON d.date = p.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(complete_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(price) AS gmv FROM trade_order WHERE complete_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY DATE(complete_time) ) AS o ON d.date = o.date ORDER BY d.date ASC

SELECT c.id AS campusId, c.name AS campusName, COALESCE(p.productCount, 0) AS productCount, COALESCE(o.orderCount, 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(u.userCount, 0) AS userCount FROM campus c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT campus_id, COUNT(*) AS productCount FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY campus_id ) AS p ON c.id = p.campus_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT campus_id, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM trade_order WHERE status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY campus_id ) AS o ON c.id = o.campus_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT campus_id, COUNT(*) AS userCount FROM user GROUP BY campus_id ) AS u ON c.id = u.campus_id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT cat.id AS categoryId, cat.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(p.productCount, 0) AS productCount, COALESCE(o.orderCount, 0) AS orderCount FROM category cat LEFT JOIN ( SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS productCount FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY category_id ) AS p ON cat.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.category_id, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM trade_order o INNER JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY p.category_id ) AS o ON cat.id = o.category_id ORDER BY cat.id ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS todayNewUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND is_deleted = 0) AS todayNewProducts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE complete_time >= CURDATE() AND complete_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND status IN (3, 4)) AS todayNewOrders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM trade_order WHERE complete_time >= CURDATE() AND complete_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND status IN (3, 4)) AS todayGmv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS totalProducts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN (3, 4)) AS totalOrders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN (3, 4)) AS totalAmount FROM dual

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0) AS pendingProductCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campus_auth WHERE status = 0) AS pendingAuthCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE status = 0) AS pendingReports FROM dual

SELECT CASE login_method WHEN 'wechat' THEN '微信登录' WHEN 'account' THEN '手机号密码登录' WHEN 'sms' THEN '短信验证码登录' WHEN 'pc' THEN 'PC端管理后台' ELSE login_method END AS methodName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM login_log
AND login_time >= #{startDate}
AND login_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY login_method ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT time_slots.timeSlot, COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) AS pcCount, COALESCE(mini.cnt, 0) AS miniCount FROM ( SELECT '0:00-1:59' AS timeSlot, 0 AS hourStart UNION ALL SELECT '2:00-3:59', 2 UNION ALL SELECT '4:00-5:59', 4 UNION ALL SELECT '6:00-7:59', 6 UNION ALL SELECT '8:00-9:59', 8 UNION ALL SELECT '10:00-11:59', 10 UNION ALL SELECT '12:00-13:59', 12 UNION ALL SELECT '14:00-15:59', 14 UNION ALL SELECT '16:00-17:59', 16 UNION ALL SELECT '18:00-19:59', 18 UNION ALL SELECT '20:00-21:59', 20 UNION ALL SELECT '22:00-23:59', 22 ) AS time_slots LEFT JOIN ( SELECT HOUR(login_time) DIV 2 * 2 AS hourStart, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM login_log WHERE login_method = 'pc'
AND login_time >= #{startDate}
AND login_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY HOUR(login_time) DIV 2 * 2 ) AS pc ON time_slots.hourStart = pc.hourStart LEFT JOIN ( SELECT HOUR(login_time) DIV 2 * 2 AS hourStart, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM login_log WHERE login_method IN ('wechat', 'account', 'sms')
AND login_time >= #{startDate}
AND login_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY HOUR(login_time) DIV 2 * 2 ) AS mini ON time_slots.hourStart = mini.hourStart ORDER BY time_slots.hourStart

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(l.loginCount, 0) AS loginCount, COALESCE(r.registerCount, 0) AS registerCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 ) AS nums WHERE n < #{days} ) AS d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(login_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS loginCount FROM login_log WHERE login_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(login_time) ) AS l ON d.date = l.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS registerCount FROM user WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) AS r ON d.date = r.date ORDER BY d.date ASC
